title: 49:24 the prey/mighty/captives. The context of 49:24 tells us that prey/captives refers to God's "covenant people," who are in bondage to the gentiles. The mighty (called "the terrible" in 49:25) could also refer to Satan, who makes us his captives when we sin. The prey shall indeed be "taken from the mighty," by God, who is mightier than all.
author: Tina M. Peterson
